name: Lady of Otaria
description: According to dwarven myth, the daughter of Gaea and the fire-god Fiers.

timeline.summary: The Sarpadian dwarf empire falls to migrating goblins and orcs, and the Lady of Otaria teleports the dwarves to safety on Terisiare.
